verdict.rationale: Databricks documents multiple mechanisms for autonomous background automation: Lakeflow/ETL pipeline orchestration (databricks-docs-1, -40), scheduled SQL alerts that monitor and notify automatically (databricks-docs-26), automation via CLI/SDK scripts (databricks-docs-2, -48, -49, -77), and Genie Code explicitly described as an 'autonomous agent that plans, runs code, fixes errors, and asks for approval before it uses tools' (databricks-docs-29), plus agent tool/MCP integration for background task execution (databricks-docs-43, -50, -71, -89). This spans both data-pipeline automation and AI-agent autonomy running unattended. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that these automations run reliably unattended in production, and explicit dedicated 'Jobs scheduler' documentation beyond pipeline/alert references.
